key_insight: A visual analytics framework links evolving cancer care team collaboration patterns with changes in AI-estimated patient outcome risk, without claiming causation.
clinical_relevance: The framework may help researchers and care teams examine collaboration patterns associated with changing risk across cancer treatment stages.
method: Build dynamic care team networks from EHR-mediated communications.
Estimate risk over time using a temporal graph neural network.
Explore networks, surrogate logistic regression explanations, and what-if scenarios through coordinated visualizations.
evidence_signal: Expert-guided analysis scenarios involved 505 patients with breast, colorectal, and lung cancers; the abstract reports no quantitative predictive performance.
watch_item: Observed associations and exploratory what-if results do not establish that changing team composition would improve patient outcomes.
paper_title: Visualizing and Interpreting Temporal Care Team Dynamics for Cancer Survival Risk Analysis
